name: Ultron, Artificial Malevolence — the token becomes a 2/2 Robot Villain only if it isn't a creature
notes: Sweep group 7 (2026-10-07). "If the token isn't a creature, it becomes a 2/2 Robot Villain creature in addition to its other types" produced nothing: tokens just made are not read as antecedents. The fired text now takes the token as a pick (restricted to tokens) and checks "isn't a creature" as the trigger resolves. A Sol Ring token becomes a 2/2 Robot Villain artifact creature; a Grizzly Bears token, already a creature, is left alone. Also locks in a state bug found on the way: on a board with no effects the fire-time snapshot lost isToken (getAllFinalStates fallback), so no token could be picked.
